decision_reason: No ghost defect observed; compact cadence and clean whole-body loop not established. Isolate the core rather than redesigning approved acting.

issues.observation: Ordered repeated tail phases recur roughly 36-42 frames (1.5-1.75s) in both modes. Exact whole-body cycles and seams remain unverified.
issues.expected: Native relaxed cadence about 0.8-1.2s and clearly faster distinct dash about 0.4-0.6s; targets, not measured acceptance.
issues.correction: Isolate repeatable core-loop performance before adding entry/brake. Return native cycle boundaries and seam-neighborhood frames for pose AND velocity inspection.
issues.evidence_limit: Inferred tail phase intervals from ordered stills, not normal-speed performance certification.

issues.observation: Sampled final approximately one second turns/settles upright. No clean 0.15-0.25s brake or arbitrary-phase exit coverage demonstrated.
issues.expected: Responsive start/loop/stop without waiting for whole source film.
issues.correction: Preserve future entry/phase-aware exit requirements. Build separately after core cycle selection, not in this loop-only take.
issues.scope: Whole start-loop-stop readiness, not a required beat in the next core-only trial.
